workflows.name: foundation-1-bootstrap
workflows.description: PBI-001 → 002 → 003 → 004, in order: scaffold, settings, PostgreSQL, user model
workflows.whenToUse: Run first, alone. Everything else waits for it.

workflows.name: foundation-2-quality
workflows.description: PBI-005, then 006 ∥ 007: lint and hooks, then type checks and the test setup
workflows.whenToUse: After foundation-1. Can run beside foundation-3.

workflows.name: foundation-3-enablement
workflows.description: PBI-008 ∥ 009: agent guide, Docker image
workflows.whenToUse: After foundation-1. Can run beside foundation-2.

workflows.name: foundation-4-core
workflows.description: PBI-010, then 011 ∥ 012: error contract, then base model with pagination, v1 routing with health
workflows.whenToUse: After foundation-2. Can run beside foundation-5.

workflows.name: foundation-5-platform
workflows.description: (PBI-013 → 014) ∥ 015: request id and logging, CORS and security headers, Entra token validator
workflows.whenToUse: After foundation-2. Can run beside foundation-4.

workflows.name: foundation-6-auth
workflows.description: PBI-016, then (017 → 018) ∥ 019: bearer authentication, /me, local sign-in, permissions
workflows.whenToUse: After foundation-4 and foundation-5.

workflows.name: foundation-7-api-docs
workflows.description: PBI-020 → 021: OpenAPI with Swagger UI, then Swagger sign-in with Entra ID
workflows.whenToUse: After foundation-6.

workflows.name: foundation-8-agent-kit
workflows.description: PBI-022 → 023: app template for startapp, agent skills
workflows.whenToUse: After foundation-7 and foundation-3.

workflows.name: studio-1-ground
workflows.description: PBI-135 ∥ 136: dependencies, Redis and the settings contract; skills clean-up
workflows.whenToUse: First of the Studio epic. Can run beside studio-ui-1-apps.

workflows.name: studio-2-platform
workflows.description: PBI-137 ∥ 138 ∥ (139 → 153): background jobs, the socket ticket, OpenTelemetry, the collector for Splunk
workflows.whenToUse: After studio-1-ground. Can run beside studio-3-data.

workflows.name: studio-3-data
workflows.description: PBI-140, then 141 ∥ (142 → 143): documents, runs, the extraction definition
workflows.whenToUse: After studio-1-ground. Can run beside studio-2-platform.

workflows.name: studio-4-live
workflows.description: PBI-144 ∥ 145 ∥ (148 → 151): the run socket and events, the scripted assistant agent, extraction records, extractor and merge
workflows.whenToUse: After studio-2-platform and studio-3-data.

workflows.name: studio-5-assistant
workflows.description: PBI-146 → 147: the assistant conversation and its reply job, then the LLM agent
workflows.whenToUse: After studio-4-live. Can run beside studio-6-extraction.

workflows.name: studio-6-extraction
workflows.description: PBI-149 → 150 → 152: corrections, then running the extract stage
workflows.whenToUse: After studio-4-live. Can run beside studio-5-assistant.

workflows.name: studio-7-stack
workflows.description: PBI-154 ∥ 155 ∥ 156: telemetry for jobs and agents, the whole stack in compose with a guide, the Studio flow test
workflows.whenToUse: After studio-5-assistant and studio-6-extraction.

workflows.name: studio-ui-1-apps
workflows.description: UI-038: choose which apps the shell offers
workflows.whenToUse: Any time. Needs no backend.

workflows.name: studio-ui-2-backend
workflows.description: UI-039 → 040: Studio over HTTP against the Django API, then a walk-through in a browser
workflows.whenToUse: After studio-7-stack, with the backend stack running (make up).

workflows.name: studio-8-fixes
workflows.description: PBI-256: the test run must not read a local .env
workflows.whenToUse: After studio-7-stack.

workflows.name: assistant-1-structure
workflows.description: PBI-263 → 264 → 265: the agent as a package, the workspace it looks through, a budget and telemetry for tool calls
workflows.whenToUse: First of the assistant epic.

workflows.name: assistant-2-tools
workflows.description: (PBI-266 → 267) ∥ 268 ∥ 269 ∥ 270: outline, survey, find, preview and record summary tools
workflows.whenToUse: After assistant-1-structure.

workflows.name: assistant-3-guidance
workflows.description: PBI-271: guidance for helping a subject-matter expert, and tools by hand
workflows.whenToUse: After assistant-2-tools.

workflows.name: projects-1-api
workflows.description: (PBI-322 → 323) ∥ 324 ∥ 325: changeable run documents, then projects; configuration versions; clearing the conversation
workflows.whenToUse: First of the projects epic.

workflows.name: projects-2-api-flow
workflows.description: PBI-326: the flow test and the guide go through a project
workflows.whenToUse: After projects-1-api.

workflows.name: projects-ui-1-services
workflows.description: UI-052: services for projects, run documents, configuration versions and clearing the conversation
workflows.whenToUse: After projects-2-api-flow, with the backend stack rebuilt and running.

workflows.name: projects-ui-2-routes
workflows.description: UI-053: Studio opens a project by its address
workflows.whenToUse: After projects-ui-1-services.

workflows.name: projects-ui-3-screens
workflows.description: UI-054 ∥ 055 ∥ 056 ∥ 057: project list, documents in a project, configuration versions and Save configuration, clearing the conversation
workflows.whenToUse: After projects-ui-2-routes.

workflows.name: projects-ui-4-walk
workflows.description: UI-058: walk through projects in a real browser
workflows.whenToUse: After projects-ui-3-screens.

workflows.name: e2e-1-runner
workflows.description: UI-096: a Playwright runner, fixtures and a smoke test
workflows.whenToUse: First of the end-to-end epic, with the backend stack running (make up).

workflows.name: e2e-2-journeys
workflows.description: UI-097 ∥ 098 ∥ 099: journey tests for projects and versions, assistant and review, privacy, persistence and phone width
workflows.whenToUse: After e2e-1-runner, with the backend stack running.

workflows.name: e2e-3-command
workflows.description: PBI-356: make e2e runs the UI tests against the stack
workflows.whenToUse: After e2e-1-runner. Can run beside e2e-2-journeys.

workflows.name: e2e-4-stability
workflows.description: UI-123: no clicks lost before the page is ready
workflows.whenToUse: After e2e-2-journeys, with the backend stack running. Can run beside e2e-5-engine.

workflows.name: e2e-5-engine
workflows.description: PBI-363: the delivery workflows run the end-to-end suite before they merge
workflows.whenToUse: After e2e-3-command. Can run beside e2e-4-stability.

workflows.name: e2e-6-checks
workflows.description: UI-124 ∥ 125 ∥ 126: accessibility scan, screenshot comparison, an optional live suite
workflows.whenToUse: After e2e-4-stability, with the backend stack running.

workflows.name: define-1-field-table
workflows.description: UI-148: the fields of a record type as a table with tick boxes
workflows.whenToUse: Any time, with the backend stack running (make up).
